description: Start a free guest session with no account. Returns guest_token (pass it to every other tool), claim_url (give it to the person: it keeps the voice profile in a free ScriptGrain account, or deletes it), expires_at and limits (one profile, one extraction, no drafts). Unclaimed sessions are archived after 7 days and can still be claimed or deleted from the same link. At most 3 sessions a day from one network; reuse the token you have.
name: start_session
title: Start a guest session
